description:
What could go wrong on the caller's own figures, priced by stage: Source,
Terms, Order, Pay, Ship, Clear, Cash.

Takes the same inputs as `test_order` and prices against the same plan.
Each row has an `exposure` (the cost if it happens), `covers` (what would
cover it) and a `lever` (that cover's cost) where one is priced; otherwise
an `absence` naming the one figure that would unlock it. `not_priced` lists
exposures this register does not price (for example LC fees, demurrage and
quality claims).

Figures carry a `provenance` stamp (READ, MEASURED, DERIVED, COMPUTED, PROXY or ESTIMATED; defined in the server instructions) and a `basis`; `missing` names any figure only the caller holds. Information, not advice.
name: risk_register
title: Risk register
